Architecture of the decomposition is excellent. The 4-file split (helpers / orch / modal / main) follows the pre-existing section comment boundaries in the original file, making the extraction mechanical and unambiguous. Module responsibility lines are clear and appropriate.

The globalThis._pdLogPreviewCleanups cross-module shared-state pattern is well-executed. This is a maintainable solution for the browser globals constraint.
